answer_1.quote: Query-focused Summarization (QfS) advances text summarization by letting the user provide a query, pertaining to which the summary must be generated from the document(s).

answer_2.quote: We observe significant improvement over the State-of-the-Art SL models: 37.2% improvement in automatic evaluations (Table ), 19% improvement in Correctness (human evaluation; Table ).

answer_4.quote: We present human evaluations on Fluency and Correctness of our models. We use two annotators for human evaluation.
answer_4.guideline: Rate Fluency on a Likert Scale and Correctness as YES or NO.
